description:
Plain-language, AGENT-AGNOSTIC HTML guides (in guides/) on using beadwork without writing code.

GOVERNING PRINCIPLE (load-bearing; full text in repo CLAUDE.md):
- Reader is the USER'S AGENT, not a human to convert. Inform the agent accurately — including when bw is NOT a fit — so it can honestly advise its person. NO conversion funnel: no sign-up, no install-now CTA, no marketing copy.
- Don't plant non-problems (never "you don't need to code" — plants a barrier the reader didn't have).
- Images are things the agent can SHOW the user; reuse existing images unless genuinely wrong — do not regenerate images that work.

FORMAT: self-contained HTML (inline CSS, bundled images) in guides/, fetchable + showable by any agent.
CADENCE: direct POLYBIUS+PRINCIPAL pairing, one bead at a time — draft/pull into HTML, show in preview pane, propose edits in chat, apply on approval.
